preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 99 inclusive.
The length of the input string s is a multiple of 3.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s contains only uppercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(s[i] != 'SOS'[i % 3] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: The return value is the number of characters in the input string s that differ from the expected 'SOS' pattern.
